content: Babse-goled-neggi dii aryomaid

Dule, Babse-goled-neg-e-dogedse gannar an-senonikid, geb yawagak-urba, dad-nakwedsik dii aryomai an daksad. We-dii dad-nakwed-argan-nuedsik danikid. Geb Babse-goled-neg-argan-nuedsik dikarbali iirmakmaid, geb dad-nakwedsik ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-aila-urbalidse dii suurmakmaid.
A-sorbali, dule, dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsik yawagak-siidba an-onosad, geb magaba neg-ebiris dad-nakwedsik yawagak-siidse an-sesad. Agi, Babse-goled-neg-argan-nuedsik dii aryomai an daksad.
Dule, dub-ganiki dad-nakwedsik noded. Dali-dulataled-ilabo gaka dulabo-gakambe-nanasadse (250) wilubsasad, geb dii-obakega an-imaksad. Dii an-nag-simmurse wirgued.

A-sorbali, baid dali-dulataled-ilabo gaka dulabo-gakambe-nanasadse (250) wilubsasbalid, geb dii-obakega an-imaksabalid. Emidi, dii an-yokorse wirgued. Geb baid dali-dulataled-ilabo gaka dulabo-gakambe-nanasadse (250) wilubsasbalid, geb dii-obakega an-imaksabalid. Ar emigindi, dii an-musirse wirgued.

Deginbali, baid dali-dulataled-ilabo gaka dulabo-gakambe-nanasadse (250) wilubsasbalid, ar dii-suurmakmaid wiladga-gudsoggu, geg an bar obakgusad. Ar bela-bela wilasoggu, unnila dommo-dommo obakleged.
Geb degine, anse egichided: “Dule-machi, ¿bela be nue daksa?” Geb sorbali, diwar-gakase gannar an-senonikid.
Geb diwar-gaka-abinbermaidgi bukidar sapimar gwigwichi an daksad.
Agi, anga sogded: “We-dii, dad-nakwedsik suurmakmaid, Arabá-yalaganse aidemaid, geb Demar-Gagbidye-nugadse nomaid. Dii a-demarse warmakdapile, demar sayee guddaed.

We-diwar bia suurmakmaioe, agi, bela ibdurgan-gudimalad dula-gudii guoed. Ar we-diwar, dii-balu-balud dii-sayegwadga-imakosoggu, egi bukidar uamar gudii guoed. Bela ibdurgan-e-diigi-gudimaloed dula-gudii guoed.

Ua-gamalad Engadi-akale, En-Eglaimʼse diwar-gakaba gudii gumaloed. Agi, e-sakimar-odinguega nasikoed. A-diwargi, ar igi Demar-Dummadye-nugadgi uamar galagwensuli, degi, bukidar nika, deyobi nikumogoed.
Ar e-neg-olligandi, degi, e-matagandi dii-sayegwad nikuosulid, unni egi balu onolegega guoed.

Sapimar-nabir-e-san-gulleged-galagwensuli diwar-gaka-abinbermaidgi dungudoed. E-gagan dinguosulid, deginbali, e-san bipisaar berguosurbalid. Nii-irbali, sanmakgwichi-guoed, ar Babse-goled-neggi dii-suurmakmaid ogedga gued. E-sanmar masga guoed, e-gagandi inaga guoed.”
Israel-yar-abingunanaid
Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi weyob soged: “Wemar-yar-abingunanaidi, Israel-dadgan-dummagan-sogambe-gakabogwad-e-waganga (12) mimilegoed. Joséʼdi sogabo yar gaoed.
Be-dadganga an ise-sogar sogsagusad, an we-yar bemarga ukoye. Emigindi, bemar na be-dadgan-war-wargwengi yopira yar nikuoed, ar we-yar bemargadid.
”Dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsik yar-abingunaid, Demar-Dummadye-nugad-akale onodagoed. Geb Hetlón-neggweburgi nasaoed, Zedad-neggwebur-dogedse bergudapoed. We-neggweburmar yarmar-abinguega guoed:

”Hamat-neggwebur, Berota-neggwebur, Sibraim-neggwebur. (We-neggweburmar-gwapaagwadi Damasco-yar, Hamat-yarbo-abingunaidgi bukwad). ”Geb degi, Hazar-Haticón-neggweburgi nasbaloed. (Hazar-Haticón-neggweburde Haurán-yarbo abingunaid).
”Weyobi, dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsik-yar-abingunaidi, Demar-Dummadye-nugad-akale onodagoed, Hazar-Enánʼse. Dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsik Damasco-yar, Hamat-yar naguoed.

”Dad-nakwedsik, Jordán-diwar yar-abinguedga guoed. Yar-abingunaidi, Haurán-yar, Damasco-yarbo-abingunaidgi onodoed. Geb Galaad-yar, Israel-yarbo-abingunaidgi nasaoed, Tamar-neggweburse. Tamarʼdi Demar-Gagbidye-nugad-walik siid. Weyob dad-nakwedsik yar abingunaioed.
”Dad-nakwed-argan-nuedsik-yar-abingunaidi, Tamar-akale onodoed, geb Meriba-Cades-diimata-naidgi, degi, Egipto-diangi nasaoed, Demar-Dummadye-nugadse. Weyob dad-nakwed-argan-nuedsik yar abingunaioed.
”Dad-argwanedsik, Demar-Dummad yar-abinguedga guoed. Egipto-yarbo-abingunaid-akale, Hamat-neggwebur-doged-asabin, demar-gaka-naidse yar abinguoed. Weyob dad-argwanedsik yar abingunaioed.”
Yar-mimilesad
“We-yar Israel-dadgan-sogambe-gakabo-gumaladba (12) be mimimaloed.

Bemargadga-guega bemar wilubdakar mimimaloed. Bemar napaneg-mimialile, dule-yar-baidgined bemar-abargi-maid be odomogoed, deginbali, bemar-abargi-maidgi e-mimmigan-gwalulesmalad be odomarmogoed. E-mimmigan, Israel-yargi-gwalulesad-ular, be Israel-dulemaryob dakoed. Degisoggu, we-dulemar-yar-baidginmalad bemarba, Israel-dadgan-sogambe-gakabogwad-e-waganba (12) napaneg nikumarmogoed.
Dule-yar-baidgined biti-Israel-dadgan-sogambe-gakabogwad-e-wagan-yargi mai, agi ega yar uklegoed. Ani an Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi weyob soged.”
